zh: 本书的写作在伯克利与纽约完成，伴随一群不断变动的师长、同事与朋友。写作过程漫长而断续，使我迟迟未能充分表达对他们的感激。我在伯克利的博士论文导师迈克尔·布若威（Michael Burawoy）通过一次次迅速而细致地评阅各章草稿，教会我政治经济学。他日常对学生课题的投入、通过教学进行的公共参与，为我树立了无价的教学典范。迈克尔 1991–1993 年博士论文小组成员——Bob Freeland、Mary Kelsey、Patrick Heller、Chris Rhomberg、Brian Rich、Suava Salameh、Anders Schuneiderman、Rob Wrenn、Mona Yunis——帮助我超越区域研究框架思考满洲。在伯克利我还幸运地得到阿莉·霍克希尔德（Arlie Hochschild）、Tom Gold、彼得·埃文斯（Peter Evans）、洛厄尔·迪特默（Lowell Dittmer）的热心支持。感谢 Troy Duster 在我写博士论文期间的鼓励。
en: The work on this book took place in Berkeley and New York among a changing cohort of mentors, colleagues, and friends. The long and intermittent process of writing this book has delayed adequate expression of my gratitude toward them. Michael Burawoy, my dissertation advisor at Berkeley, taught me political economy through his immediate, meticulous critique of myriad drafts of chapters. His everyday devotion to students’ projects and his public participation through teaching demonstrates an invaluable example of pedagogy for me. The members of Michael’s 1991–1993 dissertation group—Bob Freeland, Mary Kelsey, Patrick Heller, Chris Rhomberg, Brian Rich, Suava Salameh, Anders Schuneiderman, Rob Wrenn, and Mona Yunis—helped me think Manchuria beyond the framework of area studies. I was also fortunate at Berkeley to receive warm hearted support from Arlie Hochschild, Tom Gold, Peter Evans, and Lowell Dittmer. I appreciate Troy Duster for his encouragement when I was writing my dissertation.

zh: 到纽约大学后，我把博士论文的一部分改造为本书。哈里·哈鲁图尼安（Harry Harootunian）为我在纽约大学争取到充足的校内资源与学术支持，这对完成在中国的新一轮研究与写作至关重要。我与哈里的日常交谈、他对各章众多稿的热情阅读，使我得以把文化研究所学与政治经济学熔于一炉。感谢丽贝卡·卡尔（Rebecca Karl）对全书最终稿提出重要而建设性的建议。Wolsan Liem 对各章作了富有洞见的阅读。感谢东亚研究系与社会学系的同事朋友，尤其克雷格·卡尔霍恩（Craig Calhoun）、Doug Guthrie、罗慕士（Moss Roberts）、玛丽莲·扬（Marilyn Young）、路易丝·扬（Louise Young）、Manu Goswami、尼尔·布伦纳（Neil Brenner）、Janet Poole、Yukiko Hanawa，以及已故的多萝西·内尔金（Dorothy Nelkin）的支持。特别感谢 Osamu Nakano 与 Chia-jung Lin 在语言上的帮助。
en: Since coming to New York University, I transformed part of my dissertation into this book. Harry Harootunian has rallied for the abundant institutional and intellectual support at NYU that was vital to completing new rounds of research in China and writing. My daily conversations with Harry and his enthusiastic reading of numerous drafts of all the chapters have made it possible for me to meld my learning of cultural studies with political economy. I appreciate Rebecca Karl for important and constructive suggestions on the entire final draft of the manuscript. Wolsan Liem offered an insightful reading of chapters. I thank colleagues and friends in the Departments of East Asian Studies and Sociology, especially Craig Calhoun, Doug Guthrie, Moss Roberts, Marilyn Young, Louise Young, Manu Goswami, Neil Brenner, Janet Poole, Yukiko Hanawa, and the late Dorothy Nelkin for their support. My special thanks also go to Osamu Nakano and Chia-jung Lin for their assistance in language.

zh: 若无 1998 至 2001 年间中国延边朝鲜族学者的无价支持，本书不可能完成。朴昌昱（Pak Changwuk）教授让我了解满洲朝鲜人的历史，并提供珍贵档案材料，包括他数十年前手抄的那些。他毕生致力于撰写和教授中国朝鲜人的历史，一直激励着我。感谢 Chon Sinja 教授：我每次调研旅行她都欢迎我到她家中，介绍我认识许多不同群体的人，并督导档案材料的翻译。她的家人与朋友使我对当地的朝鲜族社群的理解超出学术圈。也感谢孙春日（Son Chunil）教授慷慨与我分享各种档案文献。本书受益于中国朝鲜族学界新的满洲研究：孙春日对土地所有制的开创性研究、金成镐（Kim Songho）对民生团的严谨研究，对我自身分析的发展至关重要。感谢 Pang Hyang 在我沈阳调研中的出色协助。也感谢延边大学及其民族学研究所各位学者的各种协助与支持。
en: This project would have been impossible to complete without the invaluable support from Korean Chinese scholars in Yanbian, China from 1998 to 2001. Professor Pak Changwuk has taught me the Korean history of Manchuria and made available precious archival sources, including those that he hand-copied many decades ago. His lifelong dedication to the writing and teaching of the Korean history of China has been an inspiration to me. I am grateful to Professor Chon Sinja who has always welcomed me to her home during my research trips, introduced me to many different groups of people, and supervised translations of archival sources. Her family and friends extended my understanding of Korean community beyond academic circles. I am also grateful to Professor Son Chunil who generously shared various archival documents with me. This book has benefited from new studies of Manchuria among Korean Chinese. Son Chunil’s path-breaking study of landownership and Kim Songho’s rigorous study of the Minsaengdan were essential to developing my own analysis. I thank Pang Hyang for her splendid assistance in my research in Shenyang. I also appreciate the various assistance and support from scholars at Yanbian University and its Institute of Ethnology.

zh: 多年来我在多伦多大学、康奈尔大学、普林斯顿大学、哈佛大学的工作坊与会议以及哈巴罗夫斯克报告过本书的部分想法。感谢组织者——Thomas Lahusen、Michael Shin、查尔斯·阿姆斯特朗（Charles Armstrong）、Dan Shao——与与会者的建设性反馈。感谢师长朋友的鼓励，包括 Hyunju Lee、具海根（Hagen Koo）、Hong Yung Lee、Alvin So、Cho Uhn、赵惠净（Cho Haejoang）、Cho Sunkyoung、Ching-Kwan Lee、Gwoshong Shieh、Michael Liu、Ronke Oyewumi、Kim Eun Shil。Suava Salameh 从研究生时代到纽约一直是我力量的源泉。感谢 Elizabeth Cosslett 及时而鼓舞人心的建议与支持。Lim Kwangbin 在我写作最紧张的某些时期，以交谈与笑声让我保持与世界的连接。
en: Over the years I have presented some of the ideas in this book at workshops and conferences at the University of Toronto, Cornell University, Princeton University, and Harvard University, and Khabarovsk. I thank the organizers—Thomas Lahusen, Michael Shin, Charles Armstrong, and Dan Shao—and participants for their constructive feedback. I appreciate the encouragement from teachers and friends, including Hyunju Lee, Hagen Koo, Hong Yung Lee, Alvin So, Cho Uhn, Cho Haejoang, Cho Sunkyoung, Ching-Kwan Lee, Gwoshong Shieh, Michael Liu, Ronke Oyewumi, and Kim Eun Shil. Suava Salameh has been a source of strength from graduate school years to New York. I appreciate Elizabeth Cosslett for her timely and inspirational advice and support. Lim Kwangbin has kept me connected to the world with conversation and laughter during some of the most intense periods of writing.

zh: 在密歇根大学社会学系与国际研究所做博士后期间，接触跨学科文化研究为我后来把博士论文改造为书奠定了基础，尽管在安娜堡我被卷入另一个项目。感谢 Gay Seidman、Michael Kennedy、Sonya Rose、Julia Adams、Howard Kimeldorf、Jeff Paige、Rick Lempert、Muge Gocek、Gretchen 与 David Cohen，他们的款待使我在一个新城市如归家园。在晚餐时、周末以及整个求职面试期间，有 Gay 和她的家人 Ben、Heinz 相伴，我很幸运。也感谢阿里夫·德里克（Arif Dirlik）在我停留安娜堡期间的支持。
en: During my post-doc years at the Department of Sociology and the International Institute at the University of Michigan, my exposure to interdisciplinary cultural studies laid the foundation for my later reworking of my dissertation into a book, although I was drawn into a different project at Ann Arbor. I wish to express gratitude to Gay Seidman, Michael Kennedy, Sonya Rose, Julia Adams, Howard Kimeldorf, Jeff Paige, Rick Lempert, Muge Gocek, Gretchen and David Cohen, whose hospitality made me feel so at home in a new town. I was blessed with the wonderful company of Gay and her family, Ben and Heinz, during dinners, weekends, and throughout my job interviews. I also would like to thank Arif Dirlik for his support during my stay at Ann Arbor.

zh: 杜克大学出版社的编辑 Reynolds Smith 始终对本书抱有信心，一路给我重要建议。他对本书坚定不移的投入是我完成修订不可或缺的条件。四位审读者提供了对我修订有价值的意见。尤其 Stefan Tanaka 审慎的阅读与评论拓展了我对时间、危机与法西斯主义的思考。本书各阶段的写作因 Jim Shaefer 与 Lise McKean 出色的文字编辑而改善。尤其 Lise 不仅使我能按时赶上各种写作期限，还把一个令人神经紧张的过程变成令人兴奋而满足的过程。当然，本书任何缺点或错误最终由我负责。
en: Reynolds Smith, my editor at Duke University Press, has kept the faith in this book, giving me important suggestions along the way. His steadfast commitment to this book was indispensable to completing my revision. Four readers provided me with comments valuable to my revisions. Especially Stefan Tanaka’s prudent readings and comments have expanded my thoughts on time, crises, and fascism. The writing of this book in its different stages has been improved by exceptional copyediting of Jim Shaefer and Lise McKean. Especially Lise not only made it possible for me to meet various writing deadlines on time but also turned a nerve-racking process into an exciting and gratifying one. In the end, of course I am responsible for any of the book’s shortcomings or errors.

zh: 感谢家人多年来的关爱与信任。Mija、Yoon Duckkeun、Hyunjoo、Moon Seongho 以灵感与不懈支持丰富了我。Sookja、Namkyu、Kim Miheh、Hyun-Sook、Stan Young 始终给我提供家外之家与持续鼓励。感谢我的侄甥辈 Jiyoun、Shin Wooseung、Eunjae、Hyewon、Kim Joosuk、Yonghoon、Justin、Minkyong、Amanda、Caroline、Seonghyun、Jooyoung 丰盈的爱与童趣。多谢 Minje 在纽约的亲切陪伴。我的父母等待本书已久。怀着全部的爱与尊敬，我把本书献给我的父亲 Park Ro Tack——他日常工作与生活的节奏是我自身节奏的基础——和我的母亲 Kim Yang Rye——她的优雅与对知识的热情与我同在。
en: I am grateful to my family for their affection and trust over the years. Mija, Yoon Duckkeun, Hyunjoo, and Moon Seongho have enriched me with inspiration and unflagging support. Sookja, Namkyu, Kim Miheh, Hyun-Sook, and Stan Young have always provided me with a home away from home and ongoing encouragement. For their bountiful love and playfulness I thank my nieces and nephews, Jiyoun, Shin Wooseung, Eunjae, Hyewon, Kim Joosuk, Yonghoon, Justin, Minkyong, Amanda, Caroline, Seonghyun, and Jooyoung. Many thanks to Minje for his good company in New York. My parents have waited to see this book for a long time. With all my love and respect, I dedicate this book to my father, Park Ro Tack, whose everyday rhythms of work and life have been the foundation for my own, and to my mother, Kim Yang Rye, whose grace and passion for knowledge live with me.
